svg.title: Figure 3.5. Equilibrium phase differences and long-distance coupling
svg.desc: Recomputed from Eq. (3.17). Solid curves are stable and dashed curves are unstable. For zero detuning the pitchfork is at beta/alpha = -1/2. The positive and negative detunings Omega/alpha = 0.15 and -0.15 are illustrative.
